title: FreeSolo: Linear-time Sparse Attention with Zero-Shot Length Extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17191v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Linear-time sequence models typically store long-context information in a recurrent state. A fixed-size state limits how much information can be stored, while hybrid architectures that add full attention for better recall incur quadratic sequence cost. Alternatively, sparse attention with continued pretraining (CPT) can extend the effective context length. Generalization beyond the trained length remains challenging, however, and CPT can be costly. We introduce FreeSolo, a native sparse attention mechanism with a short-range sliding window branch and a long-range branch that selects keypoint cells for direct token attention. Its linear-time variant, FS-L, learns to prune the prefix before query-dependent selection through short CPT. FS-B searches balanced trees with $O(N\log^2 N)$ algorithmic cost including radix-sort construction. translated_title: FreeSolo：具有零样本长度外推能力的线性时间稀疏注意力
translated_abstract: 线性时间序列模型通常将长上下文信息存储在循环状态中。固定大小的状态限制了可存储的信息量，而为了提升召回能力而加入全注意力的混合架构则会带来二次方级别的序列计算开销。另一种方案是通过持续预训练（CPT）的稀疏注意力来扩展有效上下文长度，然而超出训练长度的泛化仍然具有挑战性，且CPT成本高昂。我们提出了FreeSolo，一种原生稀疏注意力机制，它包含一个短程滑动窗口分支和一个长程分支，后者通过选择关键点单元实现直接的token注意力。其线性时间变体FS-L通过短暂的CPT学习在基于查询的选择之前对前缀进行剪枝。FS-B则以$O(N\log^2 N)$的算法代价（包括基数排序构建）搜索平衡树。FreeSolo在零样本长度外推方面优于基线方法，且无需长上下文微调。
tldr: FreeSolo提出了一种原生稀疏注意力机制，结合短程滑动窗口与长程关键点单元选择分支，在实现线性时间计算的同时获得了优越的零样本长度外推能力。
en_tdlr: FreeSolo introduces a native sparse attention mechanism combining short-range sliding windows with long-range keypoint cell selection branches, achieving linear-time computation and superior zero-shot length extrapolation.
